newsitem.title: USA: GOLF - Close shave for Nobilo in private jet.
newsitem.headline: GOLF - Close shave for Nobilo in private jet.

text.p: KOHLER, Wisconsin, July 30 - New Zealand golfer Frank Nobilo was on a private plane which narrowly avoided a collision while approaching Sherboygan airport on Sunday, NZPA reported on Wednesday.
Nobilo, his daughter Bianca, and his girlfriend Selena Seyer were travelling with dual United States Open champion Ernie Els and his girlfriend Leizel Wehmeyer when the incident occurred.

They were travelling from Orlando, Florida, to Wisconsin for the international qualifying section of the world championship of golf where Nobilo and Els played each other, with the South African winning one-up at the 18th.
Nobilo said their plane was about 350m from landing at Sherboygan, a town of 50,000 on the western edge of Lake Michigan, when a smaller plane suddenly emerged from cloud underneath them.
The pilot of Nobilo's chartered jet took evasive action and immediately climbed out of the landing.
"I've never felt so scared before in my life," said Nobilo.
"If it had not been for our pilot's quick thinking, I hate to think what would have happened, as this smaller plane appeared to be heading into land on the same strip we were intending to land on."
The privately run airport has no control tower as it is used primarily by private jets and light aircraft. A spokeswoman for the company that runs the airport said it knew nothing about the incident.
